mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 240.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering market concerns about monetary tightening and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 240.0 signals stagflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to conflicting policy pressures.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals potential monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as discount rates decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1100.0 signal weakening housing demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate economic concern.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (2017 base) indicates robust economic output, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) below 450000.0 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS < 450000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017 base) signals economic contraction, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.
